_doc: Project-level tag vocabulary. Namespaced tags stamped on AOP steps and FAQs drive step-scoped FAQ retrieval (and, later, task/guardrail routing). Controlled facets list their known values; 'attribute' is an open long-tail bucket. Unknown facets/values are ALLOWED but flagged as warnings by the draft validator — this keeps authoring frictionless while surfacing drift. Seeded now; moves to a per-project DB table when multi-org lands.
